paite: Pathian aw, ka mangbat thu ah ka aw na za inla; melmate lauhhuaina lak ah ka hinna humbit in.
heading: David La / Humbitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte kihou gukna lak ah hon sel in; thil hihkhialte buaina lak ah.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

paite: Amau namsau bang in alei uh atat-hiam ua, athu khate ngei uh thalte bang a kap ding in angim ua.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

paite: Mi gensiatbeite mundai a akaptheihna ding un; lau lou in khatvei thu in akap guih ngal uhi.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

paite: Thil gilou hih ding in sakithuhilh ua; thang aguk a kam thu bang ah akihou zel ua; "Kua'n huaite amu dia?" achi uhi.
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

paite: Thulimlouhna azongkhia ua; "Hahkattak in i zongta," achi ua, asunglam ngaihtuahna leh lungtang uh thuktak ahi ngal a.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in thal in amaute akap ding a, Thakhat in liam in a-om ding uhi.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

paite: Huchibang in, amau lei ngei a amau adou ziak in, kisui in a-om ding ua; amau mute'n alu uh asing ding uhi.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in alau ding ua; Pathian nasep agen ding uhi, athilhih piltak in angaihtuah ding uhi.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

paite: Midiktatte TOUPA ah akipak ding uh; lungtang diktat pu tengteng in asuang ding uhi.
english: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
